chess.title: Realtime Chess (beta)
chess.description: Page auto-generates name and room code. Share code with friends to play 1vs1, moves are synced via MongoDB + WebSocket. Uses chess.js rules for international standards.

status.cannotMove: You can only move your own pieces.

chess.confirmReset: End game, clear history and switch colors for next game?
chess.inviteDescription: Send this link to your opponent, they just need to open it to automatically join your chess room.

gameFlowSteps.step1: Page auto-creates room and random name when you open it.
gameFlowSteps.step2: Share room code with second player, they will play black and board will rotate accordingly.
gameFlowSteps.step3: Realtime socket makes moves appear instantly on both devices.
gameFlowSteps.step4: Click "End game" to clear history, reset board and switch colors for next game.
